title: Going Postal
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: Conman Moist von Lipwig is saved from hanging by Lord Vetinari and ordered to revive Ankh-Morpork's decaying Post Office. He must also compete with a ruthless rival, the Grand Trunk clacks company.
readIf: you want a comic fantasy about a charming rogue and a ruined institution.
skipIf: you want a serious fantasy epic with little humor.
